connector.name: GIA - Governed Intelligence Architecture
connector.registryDescription: Runtime AI governance: decision gates, human approval, hash-chained audit, compliance mapping.
connector.summary: Hosted at gia.aceadvising.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package gia-mcp-server. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the knowledgepa3 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <GIA_API_KEY> — the endpoint accepts an Authorization bearer token or a GIA_API_KEY query parameter. It does NOT accept x-api-key.
